title: Best Lighting Designers Online (2026): Home and Commercial Lighting
description: How to hire a lighting designer for homes, shops, offices or events: layouts, fixtures, renders, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Lighting designers plan how spaces are lit: homes, restaurants, shops, offices, gardens and events. They choose fixture types, positions, brightness and color temperature to create mood and make spaces work. Good lighting makes rooms feel comfortable and products look their best. Projects go wrong when plans ignore how the space is used, fixtures are hard to buy, or electrical work is planned without licensed electricians. This guide helps you get a lighting plan that looks good and works.
